name: Camp Laughing Waters
description_short: Girl Scouts of Eastern Pennsylvania's largest overnight camp, on more than 400 acres in Gilbertsville, Montgomery County, for girls entering grades 1 to 12. Known for horseback riding, it also has a pool, high and low ropes, a climbing wall, disc golf and Swamp Creek to explore; campers sleep in cabins or platform tents.

fees.name: Girl Scout membership
fees.note: Campers must be registered GSEP Girl Scouts; unregistered campers pay $45 at drop off. GSEP's financial aid page says the 2027 member year (October 2026 to September 2027) costs $25 per girl.

fees.name: Camp bus from Philadelphia (one way trip)
fees.note: Sunday and Friday trips sold separately, each $55; stops at Northeast Towers and 56th and Chestnut.

swim_waterfront_notes: Campers take a swim test at the start of the week and are grouped by ability; canoeing and off camp water trips need American Red Cross level 2.

sessions.name: Overnight camp (7 weeks; half week, full week and multi week)

notes: Check in Sunday 2 to 4 PM; full week check out Friday 4 to 5 PM, half week Tuesday 5 PM. Weekly tuition is set per program in the GSEP camp guide and event calendar, which were not posted when checked. Non members buy a membership to register.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 7 weeks June 21 to August 7 (2026: the page refers to the 2026 camp guide). Campers entering grades 1 to 12; ages derived, not stated. Bus prices from the bussing section.
